text:
elaine: heads-up: i'm drafting a new preflight + annealing flow for runtime configs (feature flags / routing biases). goal: one-click preflight that runs heuristics, a dry-sim, and returns a compact risk report before any apply. cc @omar @josh
omar: love it. product wants that card to show a small risk band (green/amber/red), estimated quota headroom impact, and a cost delta. can we also return a short list of customers that cross thresholds?
josh: question: where should validation run? control plane (recommended) or console UI? control plane lets us reuse simulation logic and guarantees identical behavior to apply. console-only validation risks drift.
meera: +1 control plane. also propose an extensible "heuristics engine" that runs several checks: quota_headroom_check, hotspot_detector, downstream_sla_projection, and cost_estimator. each returns pass/warn/fail with a short rationale string.
elaine: agree control plane. backend contract proposal: POST /api/configs/preflight_apply with payload and ?simulate=true. response: single flat report string we render. we should include preflight_id for audits. curl example: `curl -X POST /api/configs/preflight_apply?simulate=true -d @payload.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"`
ops-bot: deploybot: preflight-sim job queued (preflight-451). ETA ~7m. :hourglass:
omar: telemetry asks: emit metric config.preflight.risk_score, config.preflight.top_tenants (as labels), and sample traces with header x-rw-preflight-id. set sample_rate=0.5 for any preflight that hits WARN/FAIL to aid debugging.
josh: on rollout annealing: propose an "adaptive step" rule: base steps [5,20,50,100] but if risk_score stays low for 2 windows, accelerate; if WARN or p95 delta > 15%, backoff or auto-pause. need clear semantics in config.
meera: also add a "preflight-only mode" flag to the API so product can surface a dry_report without enqueueing any job artifacts. preflight still writes an audit entry and returns suggestions (eg: throttle windows, suggested sample_rate).
elaine: product UI wants a compact preflight card: risk band, cost delta (USD/day est), quota delta (tokens/sec), top 5 customers with % shift, and a recommended playbook step (auto-pause, pin fallback, roll forward).
omar: audit-bot: audit: preflight requested by elaine for runtime.routing.bias v42. Preflight ID preflight-451 logged.
josh: API debate: should the heuristics be declarative (yaml check definitions) or embedded code? declarative checks are easier to surface in UI and to tune but slower to iterate. leaning declarative with a small SDK for custom checks.
meera: agree declarative + small wasm-based plugin surface for specialist checks (like tenant-specific SLAs). keeps control plane safe.
elaine: rollout playbook snippet to include in the card: 1) Approve & Apply 2) Start anneal 5->20->50->100 with windows 15m by default 3) Auto-pause on SLO breach (p95 > baseline*1.15 for >10m) 4) How to force-rollback and how to pin fallback routes. example rollback command: `curl -X POST /api/configs/apply -d '{\"key\":\"runtime.routing.bias\",\"value\":0.0}' -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\"`
ops-bot: monitorbot: synthetic preflight sim started (preflight-451). logs: /infra/jobs/preflight-451/logs
omar: also add an observability helper: a page that maps trace_id -> preflight_id -> config_version so on incidents we can quickly find which preflight introduced a change. console should link trace samples to the preflight report.
josh: one more ask: preflight should output a suggested sample_rate for production rollout and a recommended temporary SLO (ttl=1h) for the canary cohort. that makes auto-pause and metrics gating simple.
meera: i'll prototype the heuristics schema and a minimal wasm hook. will also wire up audit entries.
elaine: schedule: prototype tomorrow, ship preflight API + console card next week for internal canaries. thanks all. i'll post progress and the first preflight report in this thread. :rocket:
